email.subject: Gentle Pros Dentistry: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Tom,

I checked Gentle Pros Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you patients: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors can't tap to reach you, and there's no online booking, so anyone looking to schedule after hours has to remember to call back later (or just finds another dentist). The site also isn't mobile-friendly and the images load slowly, which doesn't help.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
